selected_script.angle: Hygienic easy-to-clean alternative to easily stained, odor-retaining plastic cutting boards
selected_script.hook: Throw away those stained, smelly plastic cutting boards that harbor bacteria.

video_001_part_01.visual: A close-up handheld phone shot of a knife slicing a tomato on a yellowed, heavily scratched plastic cutting board, with juices sinking into the deep knife scars. Then, a quick transition to a silver, rectangular stainless steel chopping board with a 1cm downward-folded lip resting securely on a modern countertop. A hand cuts fresh vegetables on the clean, smooth metallic surface.
video_001_part_01.audio: Still using plastic cutting boards that trap food stains and odors? It is time for an upgrade.

video_001_part_02.visual: Handheld shot slicing raw meat easily on the metallic board. Then, a fast cut showing water rinsing away residue from the smooth reflective surface in one swipe. Ends with a neat, modern kitchen countertop view showing the clean board. Text overlay: 'Upgrade your kitchen prep today.'
video_001_part_02.audio: Super hygienic, odor-resistant, and cleans in seconds. Make the switch today.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s pain conflict: close-up of slicing a tomato on a stained, deeply scratched plastic cutting board. 3-6s product solution: transition to a silver rectangular stainless steel chopping board with rounded corners, a smooth reflective surface, and one long edge bent downward into a visible vertical 1cm folded lip resting against a clean kitchen countertop. 6-10s fast-cut scene 1: slicing fresh green vegetables on the metallic board. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA. Preserve product identity based on the reference image, keeping it rigid silver metal with no handles or grooves.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video continuation in realistic handheld phone-shot style.
